headline: Public hearings on dune fencing at 11 & 13 Bay View Avenue and a new accessory dwelling unit at 240 Lothrop Street, plus tree removals and enforcement cases.

### REMOTE PUBLIC ACCESS WILL BE PROVIDED IN THE FOLLOWING MANNER:

1. Access through the Google Meet application. This application will allow users to view the meeting and request comment using the Chat function or speaking through the computer microphone. Pursuant to Open Meeting Law, M.G.L. c. 30A, §20, the Chair may elect to recognize public comment submitted through the Chat function at appropriate points in the meeting.
    - a. Google Meet meeting login instructions:
        i. For computers, browse to the following web address: **https://meet.google.com/sbk-brkt-xjh** or go to meet.google.com and enter the 10-digit code 'sbk-brkt-xjh'
        ii. For mobile devices (tablets and iPhones/smartphones):
            1. Please go to either 'Google Play' [Android] or the IoS 'App Store' [iPhones and iPads] and download the free program 'Google Meet.'
            2. Allow the program to access your device's camera and microphone.
            3. Then click 'Enter a meeting code' and type in 'sbk-brkt-xjh'. Then click 'Ask to join.' A facilitator will enable you to enter the meeting.
    - b. Telephone: For standard telephones and cell phones:
        i. Dial the number: **1 515-207-3273**
        ii. When prompted, enter the PIN: **261 481 192#**
        iii. A facilitator will enable you to enter the meeting.

2. Applicants and/or representatives required to appear before the Conservation Commission must make arrangements to present remotely as there is no physical meeting location. Documentary exhibits and/or visual presentations must be submitted by Noon on the Friday before the meeting to conservation@beverlyma.gov, so that they may be displayed for remote public access viewing. Public comments, if any, are encouraged to be submitted in advance of the meeting.

3. This meeting will not be live broadcast by BevCam.

*The listing of the foregoing matters are those reasonably anticipated by the Chair up to 48 hours prior to the scheduled meeting time.
